title: bug: JetBrains Release Agent never sends force, so releasing a task whose seat is mid-step (a hung or crashed worker) is refused STEP_LEASE_HELD and the board has no override, although /ws forwards force for exactly this (c593eb13)
description:
Filed by defect hunt 11-03 #4 (task-130a6a5c). Evidence is from HEAD 430e4620.

PROBLEM
A seat that hangs or crashes mid-step leaves its task WORKING and assigned, with one step IN_PROGRESS. That is exactly the task a human releases from the board. The daemon refuses that release unless the caller passes `force`. The JetBrains plugin never sends it, and nothing in the plugin lets the user opt in.

Daemon (emitter and acceptor):
- packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts:735-745 (case 'RELEASE_TASK'). The comment reads "Forward `force` so the board keeps a way past the step lease. ... without this the documented human override would be unreachable from the UI that most needs it. Absent/false still means 'refuse a leased row' — the human opts in explicitly." The code then passes `force: message.payload.force === true` to release_task. This came in with c593eb13 (2026-08-20).
- packages/moe-daemon/src/util/claimGuards.ts:265-277 assertNoLiveLease: `if (force) return; if (!task.assignedWorkerId) return; ... const step = inProgressStep(task); if (!step) return; throw new MoeError(... 'pass force:true to override a confirmed-dead holder', ..., STEP_LEASE_HELD)`. The /ws call has no workerId, so assertReleaseCaller (:290-293) is a no-op and the lease check is the one that bites.
- The /ws ERROR frame carries only operation, codeName and message. error.context is never spread (WebSocketServer.ts:39-55, allowlist = the two plan revisions), so the plugin cannot read the holder, the step or the taskId from the refusal.

Plugin (consumer):
- moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeCommandSender.kt:147-156 `fun releaseTask(taskId: String, reason: String? = null)`. The payload is {taskId, reason?}, then `sendMessage("RELEASE_TASK", payload)`. There is no `"force"` anywhere under moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin.
- Every entry point ends there:
  - the card's context menu, TaskCard.kt:345-347 then onReleaseAgent;
  - MoeToolWindowPanel.kt:547-557 handleReleaseAgent: a Yes/No dialog, then `service.releaseTask(task.id, MoeBundle.message("moe.message.releasedInUI"))`;
  - TaskDetailDialog.kt:725-739, the Release Agent action, with the same dialog and call;
  - MoeProjectService.kt:555, the pass-through.
- The confirmation text (MoeBundle.properties:102) promises "The task stays claimable where it is ... and the agent goes idle". For a mid-step task the daemon refuses, the user gets a generic ERROR balloon (MoeToolWindowPanel.kt:349-355), and the hung seat keeps the task.
- The only workaround is to drag the card to Backlog or Planning, which takes the task out of its column.

EVIDENCE
- Repro: a daemon vitest drives the real /ws server and sends the plugin's exact frames. First CLIENT_HELLO as in MoeCommandSender.sendClientHello, then `RELEASE_TASK {taskId, reason:"Released from board"}`, against a task that is WORKING, assigned to w-mid, with step-1 IN_PROGRESS.
- Command: `cd /tmp/hunt-130a-A/packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/server/releaseForce.repro.test.ts --reporter=verbose`. Verbatim output:
  ```
  JetBrains frame reply: {"type":"ERROR","operation":"RELEASE_TASK","codeName":"STEP_LEASE_HELD","message":"[STEP_LEASE_HELD] Task task-1 is leased by w-mid with step step-1 IN_PROGRESS; pass force:true to override a confirmed-dead holder"}
  force:true reply: {"type":"TASK_UPDATED","status":"WORKING","assignedWorkerId":null}
   Tests  2 passed (2)
  ```
  The second case is the same frame plus force:true, and it releases the row.
- Saved in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-130a/A/: releaseForce.repro.test.ts and releaseForce.repro.output.txt. The filer re-ran it at 17:05Z with the same result.
- task-9f6a725f (VSC-6, VS Code) left force out only "because JetBrains never sends it". That is a parity argument, not a product decision. The daemon comment and the c593eb13 message both say the board is meant to have the override.

FIX DIRECTION (plugin-only; the daemon is already correct)
- MoeCommandSender.releaseTask gains `force: Boolean = false`. Add `"force": true` to the payload only when it is set. The default frame must stay byte-identical: {taskId, reason?} with no force key.
- Decide whether to force from the rendered state, before sending. A refusal cannot be correlated, because the ERROR frame has no taskId.
  - Add a small pure helper, headless-testable, that mirrors assertNoLiveLease. For an assigned task with an IN_PROGRESS implementationPlan step, it returns (holder, stepId). Otherwise it returns null.
  - When it returns a value, show a second, explicit confirmation that names the holder and the step and says a force release is for a holder you believe is dead. Send force:true only on Yes. Declining sends nothing.
  - When it returns null, the release is unchanged and sends no force key.
- Apply this to both entry points: handleReleaseAgent, which the card menu uses, and TaskDetailDialog's Release Agent action. Prefer routing the dialog through one shared handler over duplicating the logic.
- If the board was stale (a step started after the render), the daemon still refuses and the existing balloon shows. That is acceptable.

Out of scope: moe-vscode/** (a VS Code twin can be filed separately), any daemon change, docs/MCP_SERVER.md.

FILES (planner to confirm):
- moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeCommandSender.kt
- services/MoeProjectService.kt
- toolwindow/MoeToolWindowPanel.kt
- toolwindow/TaskDetailDialog.kt
- src/main/resources/messages/MoeBundle.properties (the new confirmation text)
- a new test modelled on moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeCommandSenderAccountsTest.kt

Gate: `./gradlew test` needs the jetbrains-gradle lease (mem:convention-jetbrains-gradle-lease; for traps see mem:gotcha-gradle-jetbrains-shared-box).
definitionOfDone: A new headless JetBrains unit test asserts the exact RELEASE_TASK frame MoeCommandSender sends. The default call has payload {taskId, reason} and no "force" key. The force path has "force": true. A blank reason still omits "reason", as today.

A pure helper decides when a force release is needed, and it is unit-tested. An assigned task with an IN_PROGRESS step yields that holder and stepId, mirroring claimGuards.ts assertNoLiveLease. An unassigned task, or a plan with no IN_PROGRESS step (only PENDING/COMPLETED, or empty), yields null, and the plain no-force release is used.

Both entry points (the card menu, through MoeToolWindowPanel.handleReleaseAgent, and TaskDetailDialog's Release Agent action) send force:true only after a second, explicit confirmation that names the holder and step. Declining it sends no frame, and a non-mid-step release is unchanged.
`moe-jetbrains\gradlew.bat -p moe-jetbrains test --rerun`, run under the jetbrains-gradle lease, passes, and build/test-results show the new test classes executed with 0 failures
